steps.text: From your home page, open the community you want to work on. It becomes your active community and you land on its dashboard.
steps.title: Enter the community

steps.text: The dashboard sums up the state of the active community: what needs your attention, the shared energy, the operations, and the modules the community is subscribed to.
steps.title: The dashboard

steps.text: The first tile gathers what is blocking, or about to: missing legal details, meters waiting on the grid operator, operations without an allocation key. Every row links straight to the screen where you fix it.
steps.title: Things to check

steps.text: For each sharing operation, the tile shows the shared and injected energy over the latest period with data. The operation name links to its page.
steps.title: Energy at a glance

steps.text: The tile lists the community's operations with their type. The link at the bottom opens the full list.
steps.title: Sharing operations

steps.text: "People joining" counts the invitations sent and the records still to be filled in. "Recent activity" shows the latest actions recorded in the community's audit log.
steps.title: Arrivals and recent activity

steps.text: Billing, news, dossiers and administrative deadlines only appear when the community is subscribed to the matching module. A community with no subscription simply does not see these tiles.
steps.title: The enabled modules

steps.text: At the bottom of the dashboard, the "Available modules" strip shows what the community is not using yet. An administrator can enable them from here; a manager is told whom to ask.
steps.title: Available modules

steps.text: The "Refresh" button reloads every tile at once without reloading the page — handy right after fixing something on another screen.
steps.title: Refresh

steps.text: The tiles reload one by one and settle back into their usual display with the freshest data.
steps.title: Up-to-date data
